description: This file defines the PermanentRedirectMiddleware class, which is used within the AWS SDK for PHP's S3 component. It provides middleware to handle HTTP 301 redirects by throwing a PermanentRedirectException, helping manage redirects during S3 operations.

classes.name: Aws\S3\PermanentRedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that handles HTTP 301 redirection responses in AWS S3 SDK requests by throwing a PermanentRedirectException.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function that instantiates this class with the next handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next handler callable in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Makes the object callable; executes the next handler and checks for a 301 redirect status in the result, throwing an exception if found.
